introItems: find information about your case, including the next court hearing
get to know your rights and how the criminal justice system works
whoLead: This service is for people who have been a victim of crime in England and Wales and where:
whoItems: the person or people accused of the crime have been charged by the police or the Crown Prosecution Service
at least one of the people accused of the crime have been to a court hearing about the case at least once
notConfident: If you're not confident using computers you may prefer not to use Track a case – contact your police witness care officer or the police officer in charge (OIC) of your case.
whatYouNeedHeading: What you need to use this service
whatYouNeed: To use this private beta service, you need the password from your sign-up confirmation email. If you are viewing court information, you will also need a One Login account sign-in.
safety1: If the threat of domestic violence makes you feel unsafe about using {{applicationName}}, you can use the quick exit button or press your shift key 3 times at any time to safely leave the service.
safety2: This will close the site and open the BBC Weather site, but won't delete your browsing history.
safety3: You'll need to log in again to return to the page you were using, when it's safe for you to do so.
